title: Owner Auto Policy Filed Driver Rating Table: Violation Points of a Driver Whose Exclusion Is Lifted
content:
**Violation-points relativity.** Under the company's filed driver rating, a violation-points relativity multiplies the lift share of a driver whose named driver exclusion is lifted on the Owner Auto Policy. The share is multiplied before it is rounded to the cent. The points are the driver violation points recorded on the driver's exclusion entry, the most recent driver-excluded entry on the term. When two entries share that date, the one entered first is taken.

| Driver violation points on the exclusion entry | Relativity |
|---|---|
| 10 or more | 1.3 |
| at least 5 and fewer than 10 | 1.12 |
| fewer than 5 | 1 |
| no such entry on the term | 1 |

**Threshold sides (hypothetical).** 4 points take 1; 5 take 1.12; 9 take 1.12; 10 take 1.3.
